name: onehub-ds
rules: No className, style, raw HTML elements, hex colors, px values or Tailwind classes in screens.
Space comes from `relation` (between things) and `inset` (inside a box). Never both for one space.

Every button, icon button, badge, message and piece of text is a ROLE COMPONENT named for its job: <SaveButton>, <CancelButton>, <PageTitle>, <ErrorBanner>. There is no generic <Button action=...> and no look/variant prop.
Base components (BaseButton, BaseIconButton, BaseBadge, BaseNotification, BaseText) hold the shared styles and are internal. They are never exported and never used in a screen.

If no role component fits, stop and report `needs-new-role-component: <name and job>`. A new role is added to the design system as a new component that wraps its Base. Never invent a value or reuse a role for a different job.

subtext.use: A line of text and the smaller line under it
examples: input -> its helper or error line

iconLabel.use: An icon or checkbox and its text label

choices.use: Big clickable boxes in a set. Not tabs

related.use: A pair that does one job; items in a list; a heading and the list it names. Not tabs

group.use: Different groups in the same area, stacked or side by side

region.use: The main blocks of a modal or card

insets.container: 16 across / 14 down: boxes that hold other things (sidebar)
insets.control: 22 across / 10 down: nav items, text areas
insets.controlX: 22 left/right: logo row, headings such as All Apps

components.name: PageTitle
components.use: The page's one title, h1, 18 Medium. On a page with a back arrow, use PageHeading instead.

components.name: PageHeading
components.props: title: string; backLabel?: string; onBack?: () => void; meta?: ReactNode
components.use: Back arrow + PageTitle, with an optional line 12px (related) under the title (VersionBadge). The arrow is centered on the title line.
components.avoid: Don't build a BackButton + PageTitle row by hand.

components.name: SectionHeading
components.use: Heading of a section inside a page or card, h2.

components.name: EmptyMessage
components.use: Says a list or tab is empty.

components.name: MetaText
components.use: Small facts about the page, such as the published date.

components.name: GroupLabel
components.use: Label for a group of options with no single field label.

components.name: AddButton
components.props: children: string, disabled?, loading?, type?, onClick?

components.name: SaveButton
components.props: children?: string (default 'Save'), disabled?, loading?, type?, onClick?

components.name: SaveAsButton
components.props: target: string, disabled?, loading?, type?, onClick?
components.use: Saves into another named state: 'Save as <target>'.

components.name: LanguageButton
components.props: language: string, disabled?, loading?, type?, onClick?

components.name: PublishButton
components.use: Publishes to an environment picked from its menu.

components.name: CopyKeyButton
components.use: Link icon: copy a developer key.

components.name: VersionBadge
components.use: Version pill; with `published` it holds the publish line too (Figma page header).

components.name: ErrorBanner
components.use: Inline problem the user must fix.

components.name: Form
components.use: A vertical stack that is a form.

components.name: Inline
components.avoid: Using for two things pushed to opposite edges: use Split.

components.name: Split
components.use: Two things at opposite edges with a minimum gap (title and buttons; Cancel and Save).

components.name: Box
components.avoid: Stacking an inset with a gap to make one space.

components.name: Page
components.use: The page frame next to the nav (36 padding).

components.name: TextField
components.props: label | ariaLabel, required?, message?, status?, value?, defaultValue?, placeholder?, type?, iconLeading?, iconTrailing?, onChange?
components.use: Single-line input, including search and email. status: default, prompt, valid, error, disabled, readonly.
components.avoid: A separate Email component: use type='email' and status.

components.name: SelectField
components.props: label | ariaLabel, options, placeholder?, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?, required?, message?, status?

components.name: TextArea
components.props: label | ariaLabel, value?, defaultValue?, placeholder?, onChange?, required?, message?, status?

components.name: Checkbox
components.props: label | ariaLabel, checked?, defaultChecked?, onChange?, disabled?, onAction?

components.name: OptionBox
components.use: Bordered checkbox for environments (Prod, Pre-Prod). Place in a Stack/Inline with relation='choices'.

components.name: FileUpload
components.props: label, file?, onSelect, onRemove, error?, accept?, disabled?
components.use: Screenshot upload: empty, drag-over, filled, error.

components.name: Tabs
components.props: items (value, label, count?), value, onChange, ariaLabel
components.use: Tab bar. Tab sets are data and differ per flow.

components.name: Card
components.use: The page card. Footer is pinned to the bottom.

components.name: ModalFooter
components.use: Modal footer: Cancel at start, Save at end.

components.name: Logo
components.use: Logo mark and name. Placeholder mark: replace the asset.

components.name: LeftNav
components.props: appName, language, languageOptions, onLanguageChange, sectionLabel, items, selectedId, onSelect

components.name: AppShell
components.use: Left nav on the left; top bar and page on the right.

components.name: DataTable
components.props: columns, rows, getRowKey, ariaLabel, emptyMessage? (column width: 2xs 66 | xs 96 | sm 126 | md 138 | lg 174 | xl 200 | 2xl 214 | 3xl 221 | 4xl 300)
components.use: Table with blue header; scrolls inside its card. Build cells with the *Cell components.

components.name: TextCell
components.use: Text cell, truncated (1 line, or 2 with lines=2) with a tooltip.

components.name: DropdownCell
components.use: Dropdown inside a table cell. Body text, 14 Regular.

components.name: InputCell
components.use: Input inside a table cell. Border: blue empty, neutral filled, red error.

components.name: DevKeyCell
components.use: A developer key chip with a copy button. flag='new' shows a green New pill, 'updated' a green dot.

components.name: TextAreaCell
components.use: Multi-line text box inside a table cell.

components.name: EnvironmentPairCell
components.use: Prod and Pre-Prod boxes side by side in one cell (pair with a select-all Checkbox in the header).

components.name: EnvironmentCell
components.props: environment: Prod | Pre-Prod, ariaLabel, checked, locked?, onChange
components.use: One environment box in a table row. locked = already live there, cannot be changed.

roles.how: Pick the component whose job matches what the element does. The look comes with the role.

buttons.AddButton: Starts creating something new (Add New Word, Add Dev_key). Filled.
buttons.SaveAsButton: Saves into another named state (Save as Pending_Dev_key). Filled.
buttons.PublishButton: Publishes to an environment chosen from a menu (Prod, Pre-Prod). Filled, split.
buttons.PublishToTestButton: Publishes to the test app. Filled.

iconButtons.DeleteButton: Bin, red: remove. Ask for confirmation first.
iconButtons.CloseButton: Cross: close a modal or message.

text.MetaText: Small facts about the page (published date).
text.GroupLabel: Label for a group of options.
